content: Destructive flows (verified NN/g 2018 + WCAG): confirmations only for serious/irreversible actions; never overuse (automation bias); name consequences specifically instead of Are-you-sure; buttons name outcomes (Restore/Keep) not Yes/No; progressive disclosure keeps dialogs scannable; undo beats confirmation; heavy signifiers (typed confirm) reserved for rare catastrophic actions. On mobile: destructive actions rendered in fail tone, placed away from primary thumb path, bottom sheets preferred over stacked modals.
